players.product: silica glass (fabricated quartzware) for semiconductor applications and sputtering targets (Advanced Materials segment); water treatment engineering for semiconductor plants

quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (April 2025 - March 2026): net sales JPY 1,019.9 billion, down JPY 43.5 billion (4.1%), as selling prices fell with lower naphtha prices and overseas market prices of main products; operating income JPY 95.5 billion, down JPY 3.4 billion (3.4%), as higher Engineering sales and improved terms of trade from lower naphtha and coal prices were outweighed by worse inventory valuation and higher fixed costs; ordinary income JPY 106.8 billion (up 3.6%) on foreign-exchange gains; net income attributable to owners of the parent JPY 41.6 billion, down JPY 16.4 billion (28.3%), after an impairment loss on the fixed assets of US subsidiary Tosoh SMD, which makes and sells sputtering targets.
quarterly_data.figure: net sales JPY 1,019.9 billion (-4.1%); operating income JPY 95.5 billion (-3.4%); net income JPY 41.6 billion (-28.3%)

quarterly_data.signal: Functional Products segment (electronic materials incl. quartz glass and sputtering targets), FY2026: net sales JPY 272.9 billion (up JPY 2.4 billion, 0.9%) and operating income JPY 39.9 billion (up JPY 1.3 billion, 3.4%). Quartz glass shipments for semiconductor applications fell overseas, but overall quartz glass shipments rose as the effect of an equipment accident in the LCD application was resolved; sputtering target shipments rose overseas, while selling prices fell on product mix and exchange rates. Segment production JPY 236,274 million (104.4% of the prior year); segment sales JPY 272,858 million (100.9%).
quarterly_data.figure: segment net sales JPY 272.9 billion (+0.9%); operating income JPY 39.9 billion (+3.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: Engineering segment (water treatment, core company Organo), FY2026: net sales JPY 186.4 billion (up JPY 17.1 billion, 10.1%) and operating income JPY 40.4 billion (up JPY 6.7 billion, 20.1%), as semiconductor-related plant projects in Japan, Taiwan and the US progressed smoothly and solution projects (equipment-owned services, maintenance) were strong; segment production JPY 182,051 million (115.7% of the prior year). Management states demand for automotive semiconductors is slow to recover on weak EV demand, but demand for leading-edge AI semiconductors is expanding and demand for water treatment equipment at semiconductor fabs remains firm; Organo is expanding production and delivery capacity through global hiring and training of engineers.
quarterly_data.figure: segment net sales JPY 186.4 billion (+10.1%); operating income JPY 40.4 billion (+20.1%)

quarterly_data.signal: Management states that capacity for quartz glass used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment and thin-film materials for semiconductor wiring was expanded ahead of demand; inventory adjustment in the semiconductor market took time, and the company is working to win new customers and improve productivity so the existing capacity can be fully used as the market recovers and demand grows. In fiscal 2025 (the year to March 2026) electronic materials faced a tough environment from the delayed recovery of the semiconductor market outside leading-edge fields, while orders for water treatment plants for advanced semiconductors stayed firm on the rapid expansion of generative-AI demand.

Impairment at US subsidiary Tosoh SMD (sputtering targets, Ohio): the subsidiary had invested in capacity for future demand growth but posted operating losses as shipments fell with the delayed recovery of the US semiconductor market; with the outlook for the US semiconductor market more uncertain and the timing of a demand recovery not foreseeable, sales kept falling short of plan, so the asset group was written down to fair value - an impairment loss of JPY 19,250 million, including construction in progress JPY 13,927 million and machinery JPY 3,985 million. Book value of Tosoh SMD's main facilities after the impairment (excluding construction in progress): JPY 8,806 million; 223 employees.
quarterly_data.figure: impairment loss JPY 19,250 million (construction in progress JPY 13,927 million)

quarterly_data.signal: Medium-term plan fiscal 2025 - 2027 (the years to March 2026 - March 2028): numerical target for fiscal 2030 (the year to March 2031) of operating income JPY 170.0 billion; cumulative three-year capital expenditure of JPY 220.0 - 250.0 billion (payment basis), maintained as originally planned and weighted to the Chain businesses; in the Specialty businesses (pharma and semiconductor markets) the focus is on harvesting the previous plan's investments while starting capacity expansion toward fiscal 2030. Management states the outlook for fiscal 2026 (the year to March 2027) remains uncertain as tension in the Middle East weighs on the world economy.
quarterly_data.figure: fiscal 2030 operating income target JPY 170.0 billion; capex JPY 220.0 - 250.0 billion over fiscal 2025 - 2027

quarterly_data.signal: Capital expenditure FY2026 JPY 72,675 million (Petrochemical JPY 6,501 million, Chlor-Alkali JPY 28,062 million incl. a new biomass power plant, Functional Products JPY 21,816 million led by separation and purification media capacity, Engineering JPY 3,652 million, Other JPY 3,137 million, corporate JPY 9,502 million). Plan for fiscal 2026 (the year to March 2027): JPY 99,000 million - Petrochemical JPY 31,700 million (chloroprene rubber capacity expansion at Nanyo, commercial operation targeted for spring 2030), Chlor-Alkali JPY 17,900 million (new crude MDI splitter at Tosoh Vietnam Polyurethane), Functional Products JPY 15,700 million (separation and purification media capacity at Nanyo and Yokkaichi; the new Yokkaichi facility is expected to start commercial operation in spring 2027), Engineering JPY 2,500 million, other / corporate JPY 7,300 million, site-common JPY 23,900 million (Nanyo biomass power plant, which started operating in May 2026).
quarterly_data.figure: capex FY2026 JPY 72,675 million; fiscal 2026 plan JPY 99,000 million

quarterly_data.signal: R&D FY2026: about JPY 23.0 billion with about 1,160 R&D staff; Functional Products about JPY 13.0 billion. Semiconductor themes: high-grade sputtering targets including GaN, organometallic compounds for next-generation wiring to support future device scaling, and high-performance quartz components for next-generation semiconductor manufacturing equipment. In Petrochemical, a polyethylene grade with further improved cleanliness for high-purity chemical containers used in semiconductor manufacturing is under market evaluation. Engineering (Organo, about JPY 3.4 billion) developed ORTOC, an online monitor for trace organics that raises the reliability of next-generation ultrapure water quality, and is strengthening development of high-performance materials for purifying chemicals essential to advanced semiconductor processes.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D about JPY 23.0 billion; Functional Products about JPY 13.0 billion
